turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so I have about twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class. Nobody called me first. Explain that to me, Hale.
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.

You spoke to the vice principal. I asked why nobody called me before the zero went in. Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, so who decided, and what did the vice principal say?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.
"Policy is policy." Then we'll read it together, because 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and you didn't. Which section of your procedure lets you enter a zero first?
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.
"A courtesy." Under 4.2 it's an obligation, and you met it after the zero instead of before. I'm writing that down, and if you have nothing else, I'm going upstairs to the principal.
